messages:
Priya N.: Quick note: microbatch-adaptive-scheduler (MAS) canary finished at 10% traffic. Short: p95 down ~16% on mixed-chat, tokens/sec up ~11%, cost estimate -10%. No error spike.

perf-bot: ```
MAS CANARY SUMMARY
workload: mixed-chat (avg seq 450)
baseline: p50=60ms p95=220ms p99=490ms cost=$13.0/1M tokens
canary:   p50=54ms p95=185ms p99=442ms cost=$11.7/1M tokens
delta:    p95 -15.9% p99 -9.8% cost -10% throughput +11%
canary-id: mas-1976543210
notes: best wins on medium bursts; small jitter in us-east-1 during host swap unrelated to MAS
```

Jacob H.: Nice. Any memory pressure on gpus when combining bursts?

Priya N.: Peak GPU mem +2.5% on p3 instances, well under threshold. We cap microbatch_tokens_per_host=7000 and fallback to legacy scheduler if mem>82%. Fallback occurred in 0.3% of canary requests.

Liam R.: Observability: saw a brief p50 bump in us-east-1 at 04:12 UTC coincident with infra rolling a noisy host; ops evicted it within 50s. No MAS causal link.

Priya N.: Rollout plan: promote to 35% in 12h, 70% in 36h if no flags. Auto-rollback triggers: sustained fallback_rate > 2% for 5m or cache_timeouts > 1.5% in 1m. GH #3011 has dashboards and rollback playbook.

Jacob H.: Can we add packed-batch-size histogram + per-region mem pressure to the perf dashboard before 35% bump?

Priya N.: Yep opened GH #3012 to add both. Ping me if you want a deeper trace link. Thanks all :rocket:
